profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: A Software Engineer with 5 years of industry experience with specialized skills in Frontend Engineering and Full Stack Engineering.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and owned a centralized file-serving microservice using Node.js and GraphQL, decoupling file infrastructure from multiple repositories and reducing code duplication by ~70% while improving scalability and maintainability

- Drove team-wide LLM efficiency by embedding repository context engineering into the Codex workflow, using AST-based graph embeddings to provide continuously updated, high-fidelity codebase context with zero manual overhead; reduced token spend 25% (725/month,~8.7K annualized) while sustaining/increasing engineering throughput and maintaining low defect rates

- Owned end-to-end digitization of legacy vehicle order creation, building complex, multi-step validated React forms (React Hook Form) and supporting them with Node.js and GraphQL APIs for real-time order creation, pricing, and status tracking enabling deprecation of legacy systems and reducing operational maintenance costs
Owned end-to-end development of a vehicle tracking platform, building the React web experience and a shared Python (Flask) API with SQLAlchemy and MSSQL used by web and mobile clients, enabling real-time multi-leg tracking and reducing inbound customer support volume by ~30% (30K → 20K annually) through self-service visibility

- Drove frontend quality and maintainability improvements by introducing automated testing at scale—adding 100+ React Testing Library unit tests and Playwright end-to-end coverage with mocked Apollo GraphQL APIs—resulting in fewer regressions, earlier defect detection in CI, and improved engineering standards across the team

positions.title: Software Engineer | Frontend Web Developer
positions.description:
Government of Canada - Canadian Permanent Residence Portal
   - Led the team in the design and development of an automated photo-validation tool in Angular to let users  edit photos and receive real-time feedback, resulting in reduced manual photo review time by  70%
    - Created a custom image segmentation tool in AWS Python Lambda functions and NodeJS backend that used Machine Learning models to analyze and extract facial features and validate them 
    - Created a delightful web experience in Angular that converted paper forms into an app, allowing 155k new applications to be digitally created, signed, and submitted online
   - Improved accessibility across the entire web portal to meet the WCAG 2.0 requirements 
   - Introduced Cypress testing to minimize bugs  in production for better end-to-end coverage of test cases
 
Global Spatial Technology Solutions - Machine Learning System Design
     - Rehauled a system design to make the data pipeline more efficient using such as AWS Glue, S3, ECS, RDS and designed a CI/CD process to build, deploy, monitor, and update machine learning models
    - Presented a technical report outlining improvements in building and deploying ML models through automated ML  pipelines with AWS Sagemaker, Gitlab to cut down on development, and deployment time
    - Worked cross-collaboratively to understand system limitations and requirements, and ran brainstorming sessions for the machine learning system design process which led to research and adopting ML Ops into the workflow
    - Identified gaps in the development process and helped facilitate improvements by introducing an Agile workflow for the Data Science team, to reach industry-standard velocity for a new team 

Deloitte Internal Tool - Business Agility Assessment Tool 
 - Built a React survey tool with Node.Js + Express framework that could be personalized for different clients
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Angular and +3 skills

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer | Frontend Web Developer
Product Engineer
positions.description:
Built a custom  content management system to help patients receive personalized healthcare plans from peer patients 
Rehauled and modernized the entire goal-tracking system using React, Redux, Laravel, and PostgreSQL
Made database optimizations and improved query performance bringing queries from an average of 9 seconds to 900 ms
